title: Lobotomy Sound
blurb: The internet's off-switch, in audio form. The lobotomy meme is about voluntarily declining to process reality — hearing news and choosing, consciously, not to let it in — and the joke is dark enough that everybody laughs slightly guiltily. It plays when somebody watches one more brainrot video than was advisable, or achieves the thousand-yard stare halfway through a conversation they agreed to have. Play it when the alternative is engaging with something you have decided is beyond you. Blissful emptiness, selected deliberately over comprehension.
origin: From the 'lobotomy' meme genre — choosing empty-headed bliss over reality.
